result.question: Why did Uzziah dig many cisterns?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.

assessments.reason: The passage states, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he…dug many cisterns,” giving that as the reason.

result.reason: The text explicitly links Uzziah’s digging many cisterns to having much livestock in the foothills and plain.
